signal: Lumen announced plans to acquire Alkira for $475M and Alkira launched its Connect Partner Program

email.body1:
Kevin, saw Alkira launched its Connect Partner Program and is heading into the Lumen acquisition.

Moments like this usually surface far more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is exactly where pipeline leaks before reps can ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alkira off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Alkira.

With a partner program ramping and an acquisition in motion, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alkira needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alkira's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Alkira either way.
